message:
You know, I’ve always been the gloriously over-prepared person in my family. Just last month, I found myself organizing my pantry for the umpteenth time. I stumbled upon a stash of canned goods from a storm we had four years ago. In my defense, they were still safe — I checked! 

But it got me thinking: sometimes, being ready means just keeping an eye on what you have. I like to think I’m giving my future self a little gift each time I clear out some clutter. 

What’s your best tip for staying prepared without going overboard? 😊
